cand.title: Impact Investing: Can We Reconcile Values and Value?
cand.organizationName: UNIGE centres CDBF, GFRI and GCP
cand.excerpt: Medium-high: international multi-day conference; venue and accommodation incomplete.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified relationship candidates, not verified contracting buyers: Mara De Monte, Executive Director of GCP, is the strongest initial operational-routing contact; Giulia Neri-Castracane, Associate Professor and head of the commercial-law department, is a named co-lead of the associated impact-investing research project and a relevant academic sponsor/referral. Neither source establishes hotel procurement authority or conference-budget control. Mark Kramer is the advertised keynote speaker, not an evidenced buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming within the requested horizon: 3–5 February 2027. The official conference page explicitly says “From 3 to 5 February 2027”. The public component is separately advertised for 4 February 2027, 18:00–20:00, at Campus Biotech. Do not collapse the three-day academic conference into the two-hour public component. Registration deadline: 22 January 2027. The form title and header say 2027, but one consent sentence says February 4, 2026; this appears to be a typographical error (inference), contradicted by the main announcement and October 2026 save-the-date. No subsequent edition was found.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief and published event format/location: weak fit for primary day-meeting or catering capture at YOTEL Geneva Lake, because a public component is already located in Geneva city and Founex is not central Geneva. A limited visiting-speaker/researcher lodging or separate small planning-workshop role is conceivable only after confirming uncommitted demand and acceptable transfers. No evidence supports any block size, including the hotel’s 20–120-room planning range, or use of all 237 rooms. Attendance is unknown, so neither an oversized nor undersized event can be asserted. This is an urban academic-conference lead, not an evidenced resort retreat. Banquet/catering capacity at the hotel remains unverified.
findings.venueCommitments: Campus Biotech is the published venue for the 4 February public component only; Chemin des Mines 9, 1202 Geneva, Sécheron, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva city, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte or the airport corridor. Exact room and venues for the academic sessions on 3–5 February are not published in the reviewed announcement. This is a published venue designation, not proof of a signed venue contract. No Lausanne or French-border activity is identified; no delegate airport-routing or La Côte lodging evidence was found.
findings.historicalRotation: No previous edition of this exact titled conference, host-hotel timeline, or destination rotation was established. Related impact-investing research runs 1 September 2024–31 August 2028; research continuity is not event recurrence. The 2027 ERNOP conference appearing in the same organizer materials is a different event and must not be used as this conference’s recurrence or venue evidence.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No edition-specific housing bureau, PCO, host hotel, published room block, hotel list, booking code or open RFP was identified in the reviewed official conference page, registration form and project materials. Hotels listed for this edition: none found. No source states that lodging is open or centrally contracted. The conference page says “Additional information will be added to this page as it becomes available.” That is not a hotel-sourcing statement. Attendance, peak rooms and room nights are not published; no demand estimate is defensible from the three-day duration alone.
findings.organizationStructure: University-led academic event, not an independent association or corporate conference: UNIGE’s CDBF, GFRI and GCP jointly host it. GCP operates within UNIGE under the rectorate, autonomously with its own staff; Nicolas Duvoux is Head and Mara De Monte Executive Director. No external agency, PCO, DMC or housing intermediary is identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The evidenced incumbent is Campus Biotech for the public session, not an incumbent hotel. No competing hotel commitment, sold-out inventory, overflow requirement or venue-capacity shortfall was found. Do not pitch displacement of the advertised public session or treat international participation as proof of airport-corridor lodging demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Make one targeted qualification approach to Mara De Monte, asking her to route to the person coordinating visiting-speaker accommodation and the three-day academic programme. Confirm all academic-session venues, any existing lodging arrangement, who pays/books, visitor nights and room counts, and whether Founex transfers are acceptable. Include Giulia Neri-Castracane for research-programme context/referral, not presumed purchasing authority. Offer a tailored ancillary-lodging or small-workshop proposal only if demand is uncommitted and geographically suitable; otherwise retain a light relationship record rather than an active group quotation.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Public participation is free with mandatory registration; that does not mean supplier access or a hotel tender is open. Commercial accessibility remains unconfirmed: accommodation buyer, central-contracting status, room demand and transfer tolerance are unknown. Not currently sales-qualified as an open room-block or catering lead.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship-development inference only. The related research project continues to August 2028, providing a reason to ask about separate workshops, but no repeat conference dates or sourcing cycle were found. Do not label the series annual, recurring competitive capture, or a confirmed future hotel opportunity.

Ask Mara De Monte to identify the accommodation coordinator and verify commitments, visitor room demand and Founex transfer acceptability before qualification.
If current lodging is committed or city-only, ask whether a separately budgeted research-team workshop is planned within the horizon; do not create an undated recurring event.
